title: Sign / whiteboard photo
description: A phone photo of a sign, whiteboard or taped notice. The image slot 'photo' holds the AI scene with a blank sign surface; the template writes the sign text onto it at 'placement' so the words are exact.

text.description: Sign text. Newlines start new lines. Keep it short (a sign, not a letter).
examples:
GATE A1 CLOSED
SX 1245 ATLANTA
NOW AT GATE A12
SORRY!

style.description: marker = handwritten dry-erase on a whiteboard; printed = bold printed sign; paper = printed sheet taped up; led = orange LED message sign.

placement.description: Where the blank sign surface is in the photo, in percent of the image (0-100), plus an optional rotation in degrees.

fontSize.description: Text size in CSS pixels at 1216 px image width.

sceneBrief.description: Image prompt for the photo with a blank sign surface (not printed). Describe the blank surface positively.
examples: Smartphone photo of a blank white dry-erase whiteboard on an easel at an airport gate

caption.description: Optional caption strip under the photo (e.g. where it was posted).
